name: navigation_cycles
js: (async()=>{const W=(f,ms=60000)=>new Promise((r)=>{const i=setInterval(()=>{let v=false;try{v=f()}catch(e){}if(v){clearInterval(i);r(true)}},20);setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(i);r(false)},ms)});const T=async(f,ms)=>{const t=performance.now();const ok=await W(f,ms);return ok?Math.round(performance.now()-t):'TIMEOUT'};const tabs=['Validation','Changes','Context','Plan','Attempts','Evidence','Overview'];const list=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.ck-list button')];const big=()=>list().find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Implement the whole thing'));const heaps=[];const slow=[];for(let c=0;c<100;c++){const target=c%2===0?big():list()[1+(c%9)];if(target)target.click();for(const t of tabs){const x=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()===t);if(x){const t0=performance.now();x.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25));const d=performance.now()-t0;if(d>400)slow.push({c,t,ms:Math.round(d)})}}if(c%20===0)heaps.push({cycle:c,heap_mb:Math.round((performance.memory?performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize:0)/1048576),nodes:document.querySelectorAll('*').length});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40))}heaps.push({cycle:100,heap_mb:Math.round((performance.memory?performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize:0)/1048576),nodes:document.querySelectorAll('*').length});window.__marks.push(['cycles_end', window.__lag.length]);return {heaps,slow_tab_switches:slow.slice(0,10),slow_count:slow.length}})()
